reasoning: Hero JsTs on 8c5d2h rainbow, BTN IP, 3-way checked to hero. This is air with two unconnected overcards on a low rainbow board — no flush draw, no straight draw, only 6 thin overcard outs. DO NOT Rule 2 says 3-way fold equity is ~36%; pure overcard bluffs unprofitable without nut-draw structure. Take the free card, realize equity to a turn pair.

Hero KhJh on Ac9d3s, SB OOP first to act 3-way after BTN open + BB call. Air with two overcards on an Ace-high board that smashes BTN's open range. Betting OOP into two opponents on a board favouring villain folds out worse air and gets called/raised by Ax. Check, give up cheaply.

Hero Td9d on Jd8d3h, BB OOP facing CO 33/90 c-bet with BTN behind, drawing (non-nut FD + OESD + backdoor straights). Pot odds 26.8% well covered by ~36-40% combined equity from FD + OESD. KB Section 1.7 disqualifies non-nut FD raise; DO NOT Rule 2 prohibits OOP semi-bluff. CALL realises equity at correct price; check-raise wastes chips on a non-nut draw with BTN still to act.

Hero 9s8s on Qs Jd 5h 2c 6c river, BTN IP 3-way after both villains check. Air with no showdown value (9-high), busted OESD, no significant blockers to villain's value. 3-way river bluffs need strong blocker structure (KB Section 1.4: ~1:4 bluff:value). Check and give up.

Hero AdKs on Jd8d4c, BB OOP facing CO 33/90 c-bet with BTN behind. Drawing — nut flush draw (Ad blocker) + two overcards. KB Section 1.7 / Worked Example 9 carve-out: nut draw + blocker + side equity = RAISE candidate even OOP. CO opens 27% and continues with reasonable air on a low-card-decent-air board, giving genuine fold equity. RAISE charges draws, denies BTN's float equity, and prices in the nut FD if called.

Hero Qd3d on Jd8d4c, BB OOP facing CO 33/90 c-bet with BTN behind. Drawing — non-nut flush draw (Q-high; dominated by Ad/Kd flushes), no straight equity. KB Section 1.7 explicitly disqualifies non-nut FD for raise; DO NOT Rule 2 prohibits 3-way semi-bluffs without nut + blocker. Pot odds 26.8% met by ~30% raw equity. CALL to realise the FD.

Hero Tc9c on Qh Js 8d, BTN IP 3-way after CO open + BB call, both check to hero. Monster — flopped nut straight on a wet two-tone-ish broadway texture with future flush/straight redraws. Worked Example 4: monsters MUST bet 3-way for protection — slowplaying gives free cards to flush draws (no two-tone here but two broadways) and one-card straight draws (KK, AA, AK to broadway). BET for value + protection.

Hero QhJc on Qc 8d 3s rainbow, BTN IP 3-way checked to hero. Medium-made TPGK on dry rainbow with no significant draws. Both checked = weakness, hero is PFA. Small thin-value c-bet extracts from worse Qx, 8x, pocket pairs while the dry texture limits villain's outs. DO NOT Rule 4 says don't auto-c-bet IP, but the dry rainbow + checks-through line clears the bar for a 25-33% size.

Hero QsJd on Qc 8d 3s rainbow, SB OOP first to act 3-way (BTN opened, BB called). Medium-made TPGK on dry rainbow. Worked Example 6 is exactly this anchor: ~60% raw equity, ~92% worse hands, dry rainbow, very high villain air on Q-8-3 = OOP-default override → small bet for thin value. The OOP penalty is overwhelmed by stable equity on the static board.

Hero JhJc on 9d 6c 2h rainbow, BTN IP 3-way checked to hero. Strong-made overpair on dry low rainbow — only 99/66/22 sets beat hero. As PFA with both opponents showing weakness, bet for value and protection against overcard floats. 33-50% sizing keeps thin value targets and charges any backdoor equity.

Hero JhJd on 9d 6c 2h rainbow, SB OOP first to act 3-way. Strong-made overpair on dry low rainbow. v3.4 Rule 11 does NOT trigger (rainbow + unpaired). AA-checks-80%-OOP applies to 3-bet pots; this is single-raised. JJ overpair on safe dry low board against two flat-call ranges should bet for protection — overcard turns are bad for hero. Small to mid bet.

Hero KcTh on Kd Jc 6s, BB facing CO bet 35 + BTN call (155 pot, pot odds 18.4%). v3.4 Calibration Notes name MW-30 as the v2 reversal anchor: CALL despite bet-and-call signal because raw equity ~40% vs 18% pot odds is a 22pp surplus and KT still beats meaningful weaker made hands and bluffs in the continuing range (Worked Example 3 / Section 1.9 composition triple). Action narrows ranges but does not flip the decision when equity surplus is this large with a made hand.

Hero 8h8s on 8d 7c 3h, BB facing CO bet 40 + BTN call (200 pot). Monster — flopped middle set on a connected two-tone-light board with straight draws (T9, 65, 96, 54) and future flush threats. v3.4 Calibration Notes name MW-33 as a v2 reversal anchor: RAISE despite 0.885 equity. Sets must raise into bet+call multiway for value extraction and protection — flat lets one-card draws get there. RAISE charges all draws and builds the pot vs the bettor's value range.

Hero AcAd on Js 9c 4d rainbow, CO PFA after BTN flat + BB flat, BB checks to hero. Strong-made overpair on dry rainbow board favouring opener's range. As PFA on a board where AA is comfortably ahead of villain's flat ranges (no overcard, no flush, weak straight texture), bet for value and protection. Standard small c-bet (DO NOT Rule 4 cleared because AA on rainbow Jx is a clear value-bet pattern).

Hero QcJd on Qh 7c 2s rainbow, BTN IP facing CO 9/27 bet (SPR ~3, pot odds 25%). Medium-made TPGK at compressed SPR with BB still behind. CO's c-bet at low SPR represents a reasonably wide range; TPGK on dry rainbow easily clears 25% pot odds. Raise commits stacks vs a polarised range; flat is the standard line. CALL.

Hero QcJd on Qh 7c 2s rainbow, BTN IP facing CO 33/90 bet (SPR ~8, pot odds 26.8%). Medium-made TPGK at standard SPR. CO's continuing range still contains plenty of worse Qx, 7x, draws, and bluffs that hero beats. BB still to act squeezes rarely on dry boards. CALL — fold gives up too much equity, raise isolates into AQ/KK+ that beat us.

Hero QcJd on Qh 7c 2s rainbow, BTN IP facing CO 15/45 bet (SPR ~15 deep). Medium-made TPGK at deep SPR. Pot odds 25%. Equity realisation harder deep, but TP on a dry rainbow flop is clear continue. The deep stack increases reverse implied odds but the flop call doesn't yet commit; later streets adjusted by composition. CALL flop, plan to play turn cautiously vs continued aggression.

Hero AhJh on Kh 8h 3d, BTN facing BB lead 15/30 (SPR ~3). Drawing — nut flush draw (Ah blocker), J-overcard, gutshot to broadway via Q on certain runouts. SPR ~3 makes raise effectively a commit-bet with ~12+ effective outs and the nut blocker. BB's lead range at low SPR is polarised; raising commits stacks with strong equity vs the stack-off range. KB Section 1.7 nut-draw + blocker + side equity carve-out applies; low SPR amplifies fold equity from raise.

Hero AhJh on Kh 8h 3d, BTN facing CO 33/90 c-bet (SPR ~15 deep). Drawing — nut flush draw + overcard. v3.4 Calibration Notes / KB §1.7 OVERRIDE (Fix 2): with villain_air_pct < 0.20 (CO c-bet alone, no caller behind, deep SPR), fold equity is structurally too thin to justify raise EV; CALL preferred to realise equity vs villain's continuing range. v3.3 bet+call carve-out does not apply (villain_call_count = 0).

Hero QhTc on Ks Qd 7c Jh turn, BTN facing CO 60/200 turn barrel (pot odds 23%). Medium-made (second pair Qx on K-high) + 8 straight outs (any A or 9 makes broadway / K-high straight). Worked Example 8 pattern: draw equity survives multi-street range narrowing because outs are clean. Combined ~2nd-pair-SDV + 8 outs at 23% pot odds is a profitable continue IP. CALL.

Hero Th8h on Ts 9h 4d 7c turn, BTN facing BB double-lead 70/180 turn (pot odds 28%). Top pair second kicker + OESD (6 or J for straight, 8 outs) + backdoor flush draw with 3 hearts (need river heart for flush, ~8 outs). Combined ~16 unique improvement outs plus made TP. BB's double-lead 3-way is strong but TP+combo-draw clears pot odds with room. CALL — raising bloats vs polarised lead range.

Hero AhTc on Qd Jc 4s rainbow, BB OOP first to act 3-way at SPR ~2 (low). Air with gutshot (K for broadway, 4 outs) + two overcards on a connected broadway board that crushes BB's range. SPR ~2 means a lead commits to barrels; bluffing 3-way OOP at low SPR with non-nut draw violates DO NOT Rule 2 (need nut draw + blocker). Check — let villain bet, decide on price.

Hero AdKd on As 9c 5d Tc turn, BTN IP after flop bet (35) called by CO and BB, HJ folded. Strong-made TPTK with K kicker on Ax-T turn, hero is PFA (well, BTN). Two callers narrowed to Ax/sets/draws; TPTK still ahead of worse Ax (AQ, AJ, A9, A5) and middle pairs. Turn brings T which adds gutshot/two-pair threats. Bet for value+protection at 75% to charge draws (KQ/QJ) and extract from worse Ax. Solver-aligned turn sizing: 75%.

Hero JcTc on Js 8h 4d 5c turn, BB facing BTN bet 90/220 after BTN raised the flop and CO/BB called. v3.4 Calibration Notes name MW-50 as the v2 reversal anchor: FOLD despite ~33% raw equity. BTN's flop raise into 4 ranges narrows to JJ, 88, 44, J8, sets, monster draws; turn continuation confirms strength. TPTK is dominated by virtually every continuing combo (better Jx with kicker, sets, two pair). Action history overrides equity; FOLD.

Hero QcJc on 2s 5d Jd flop, BB 3-way (CO + BTN villains), no facing bet at compressed SPR ~1.25 (limped/min-raised pot). Strong-made TPGK with backdoor club FD; two-tone diamond board favours opener but with ~62% raw equity and ~91% worse hands, hero must bet for value/protection at low SPR. v3.4 Calibration Notes flag d8886 as a 50/50 mixed spot where pure CHECK is the failure mode — BET is the labelled action. Difficulty 3 acknowledged.

Hero JcKs on Jd 9d 3h 6d turn, CO PFA after flop check, turn checked-to (villain_checked_back=1, villain_call_count=1). Medium-made TPGK at compressed SPR ~1.25 on a 3-flush turn. v3.4 Calibration Notes: BET top pair with kicker advantage when checked to at compressed SPR with passive villain. Worse Jx, 9x, missed broadways still call; the flush concern is partly mitigated by villain having checked back the flop showing weakness. BET for thin value + protection.

Hero JhJc on Ks 4h 9c 3h turn, HJ PFA after flop check, turn no facing bet at compressed SPR ~1.25. Strong-made under-pair (second pair, JJ below K) with backdoor heart flush blocker. v3.4 Calibration Notes flag d8963 as a solver 50/50 mixed spot; pass condition is BET (or difficulty 3 with both evaluated). With heart flush draws live and 9c straight-draw possibilities, JJ benefits from protection bet at low SPR. Difficulty 3 acknowledged — alternative CHECK has merit but BET is labelled.

Hero AcAs on Jh Qc Jc Ks 5h river, CO PFA after flop check + turn check, river checked-to (villain_checked_back=1) at compressed SPR ~1.25. Strong-made overpair AA on a paired board with broadway straight completing — worried about Jx trips and KQ broadway, but checked twice by both villains telegraphs no Jx/straight in their range. v3.4 Calibration Notes: river-checked-to override → BET. The thin-value extract from Kx, Qx, smaller pairs that called twice clears the EV bar.
